text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, we're here! This is what I consider
the most cute spot—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: A m-m-m... maid cafe?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
The test shoot ended pathetically.
Without getting that best photo—
that cute photo.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
So by fully enjoying a maid cafe,
we'll make the ultimate cute our own!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Making cuteness our own, huh...
Hmm, makes sense.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, I'm in! Let's enjoy the hell
out of this maid cafe!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh~, so this is what it looks like inside.
Should we order something for now?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah! Let's just order
something that feels cute!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ummm... Maid! I'd, I'd like...
the "Lovely Photo Lottery" thing!

text_block_list.name: Maid
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay, certainly~♪
You draw a lot, and we'll take a photo together
in the pose written on it☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: What I drew is... "Heart Pose"?!

text_block_list.name: Maid
text_block_list.text:
Then please follow my lead, Master~♪
Spin a lovely heart☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Fuguuugh...?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ghhhuuu~~!! Not working at all!
Isn't this just the same as during the test shoot?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Then I'm next!
I'll show you how it's done!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
(? ...Quite confident, aren't ya...
Does she have a secret trick for being cute?)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, what's my prompt... "Cat Pose", huh.
Heheh, just watch me!

text_block_list.name: Maid
text_block_list.text:
Here we go then~♪
Nyaan nyaa~~n☆

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: THAT PREY IS MIIIINE—!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Wha...?! Where in the world is the cuteness in that?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Duck Pose" is a form
healing its wounded wings...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
This ain't any different from usual...
...and yet...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If it's "Heart Pose", do it like this!
My heart is right here, baby!!

text_block_list.name: Maid
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek! That was so cool♪
You're the first Master to pose like that☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Kuku... Ahaha! That's definitely you!
Enjoying it to the absolute max, damn it!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
'Course I am! I mean—
we came here today to enjoy a maid cafe, right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So I enjoy it in my own way.
Even for that feature—
I wanna make it a photo I can truly call "the best" from the bottom of my heart.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
(Ah... That's what it was.
Vodka wasn't fretting over "cuteness" at all.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
(...From the very beginning, she was chasing after
a photo that was the absolute most true to herself...!!)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I can only ever be me.
Or rather—only I can become the "greatest me".

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Don't you think so, Hishi-ama-senpai?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Haha! ...—Look at you, talkin' big!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—While out shopping, I saw Vodka and Hishi Amazon
coming out of a cafe.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, you're back to your usual self, Hishi-ama-senpai!
I'm looking forward to the real shoot!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Yeah, brace yourself! I'm gonna blow everyone's minds!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The smiles on Vodka and Hishi Amazon
seemed brighter than the midday sun.
